Republicans Spread False Rumor About James Talarico, Reports Say

Reports indicate that Republicans promoted a false rumor claiming that James Talarico, a candidate, was a patient at an Ohio hospital. The hospital has stated that Talarico was never a patient there. This narrative has been described as a debunked conspiracy theory by some outlets, with attempts by Republicans to discredit Talarico reportedly backfiring.
